title: Tailscale
comment: tailscaled's state directory (tailscaled.state with the node key and the machine's identity) carries as one tree; the Daemonless image runs tailscaled with --state=/config/tailscaled.state in userspace-networking mode, so the node keeps its identity but routes and exit-node advertisements are TS_EXTRA_ARGS on the application, and the jail's kernel tun is not carried. No port is published. Target ownership corrected 2026-09-29 (static re-validation against the current image contract): the image runs tailscaled as root and declares no PUID/PGID, so carried state stays root-owned.

drop: network capabilities: the compose file cannot grant them; add cap_add NET_ADMIN and the /dev/net/tun device on the Linux host before the first start
